contacts.name: Captain Ebi Tamuno
contacts.bio: Has piloted every channel in the Silverline creeks since he was twelve. Sings to his outboard engine. It sings back.

contacts.name: Engr. Nkechi Amadi
contacts.bio: The only person at Deltacrest Petroleum who reads the safety reports. Tough, dry, allergic to nonsense.

contacts.name: Mr. Pius Okorie
contacts.bio: Gold watch, soft voice, endless contracts. Believes everything is negotiable, including the truth.

contacts.name: 'Commodore' Dakoru
contacts.role: Boss of the Silverline Boys smuggling crew
contacts.bio: Self-promoted commodore of a navy of one stolen gunboat. Fictional menace of the creeks.

safehouses.name: Room above the mechanic shop, Mile Three

missions.title: Garden City Welcome
missions.summary: Fresh off the night bus at Mile Three. Baba Sule's cousin, Captain Ebi, runs boat taxis and needs a deckhand who can steer.

objectives.text: Find Captain Ebi at Mile Three
Take the wheel of Ebi's boat taxi

missions.title: Rain on Mile One
missions.summary: The rains have flooded Mile One. Ebi's sister's fish stall is floating away. Get a pickup through the flood before the stock spoils.

objectives.text: Get them to the cold room

missions.title: Crane School
missions.summary: Engr. Nkechi is short a crane operator at the Delta Basin yard. 'You drive danfo in Lagos? Then this is easy. It's not. Listen.'

missions.title: Convoy of Tankers
missions.summary: Mr. Pius pays well to keep his tanker convoy safe on the creek road. The Silverline Boys disagree.

objectives.text: Escort the 3 tankers to the depot

missions.title: Soot and Secrets
missions.summary: Nkechi suspects the 'tank cleaning' contract is dumping waste into the creeks. Under cover of soot haze, sneak in and take photos.

missions.title: Creek Chase
missions.summary: The Silverline Boys grabbed Ebi's best boat — with Nkechi's photos on board. Chase them through the mangroves; Marine Patrol joins the party.

missions.title: Yard on Fire
missions.summary: Someone sabotaged the yard's valves to cover their tracks. Fire is spreading and workers are trapped. Rescue them, then shut the master valve.

objectives.text: Use the crane to clear debris from the master valve
Hold off the saboteurs while Nkechi shuts it

missions.title: Platform Ekene-9
missions.summary: The trail leads offshore. Stow away on a supply vessel to Platform Ekene-9 and find who's been signing the dumping contracts.

missions.title: Oil Money
missions.summary: The ledger is signed by Mr. Pius — and above him, an Abuja 'Big Man'. Pius offers a fortune and a plane ticket to make it go away. Take the money... or the evidence.

objectives.text: Meet Mr. Pius at the Garden Reserve club
Take the deal, or keep the evidence
Either way, someone wants you gone. Get out.

missions.title: Regatta Racer
missions.summary: Ebi entered you in the waterfront regatta. Don't embarrass him.

hustles.name: Creek Boat Taxi
hustles.description: Ferry passengers between the waterfront and creek villages. Smooth rides, big tips.

hustles.name: Yard Crane Shift
hustles.description: Stack containers at Delta Basin. Precision pays; dropped containers come out of your wages.

hustles.name: Warehouse Forklift
hustles.description: Move pallets of pipe fittings against the clock.

businesses.name: Garden Bukka
businesses.description: Fisherman soup and starch. Yard workers' lunch spot.

businesses.name: Creek Express Boats
businesses.description: A fleet of boat taxis running Ebi's routes.

businesses.name: Yard Supply Co.
businesses.description: Honest parts and PPE for the oil yards. Nkechi approves.
